fix.item: Implemented functionality to replace tokens inside a button URL with variables provided by the module for better click tracking.

addition.item: Expanded the language strings for the button inline help to explain the available tokens.
Added extra default text-white class to improve button text visibility.

remove.item: Removed size parameters from manifest file fields.
Removed unnecessary btn-group-yesno class from manifest configuration file.

fix.item: Improved handling of short screens without a scrollbar.
Improved check for exclude queries to exactly match the input inside the module configuration.
Updated the GitHub repository name and removed broken link at the bottom of the README.

addition.item: Added GNU General Public License version 2.
Implemented a named handler function for the scroll listener that disables it when the slideout box appears.
Added class btn-group-yesno to radio buttons inside the manifest configuration file.
Added changelogurl tag to the extension manifest XML file to link versions to changelogs in the manage view.
Added changelog entries for all versions to the update directory.

change.item: Implemented AbstractModuleDispatcher override of getLayoutData instead of dispatch.
Changed module variable inside the template file due to AbstractModuleDispatcher implementation.
Changed order of statements inside the template file to move variable declaration after web asset loading.
Updated versions of asset items inside the joomla.asset.json file.
Standardized items and corrected URLs inside the update server file.
Replaced Factory call for Document object and instead obtained it from the module application object.

remove.item: Removed author URL, author email, and element from manifest file.

fix.item: Fixed CSS item display inside the box.
Fixed the content type inside the manifest file.

addition.item: Added support for opening links in a new tab when pressing the button.
Added more flexibility with content classes.

change.item: Moved early exit logic into the dispatcher.
Properly implemented the script file in the manifest.

remove.item: Removed unnecessary loading of language strings.
